mapper.sql: select answer_id, exam_id, student_id, question_id, student_answer, score, is_correct, grader_id, grading_status, answer_time, file_path, submit_time, typing_speed, accuracy_rate, completion_rate, preview_status, preview_path, preview_retry_count, preview_last_retry_time, preview_error_message from biz_county_exam_answer
mapper.select: where exam_id = #{examId} and student_id = #{studentId} order by question_id asc

select a.* from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id where a.exam_id = #{examId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and a.student_answer is not null and a.student_answer != '' order by a.answer_id asc

select a.* from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id where a.exam_id = #{examId} and a.question_id = #{questionId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and a.student_answer is not null and a.student_answer != '' order by a.answer_id asc

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id where a.exam_id = #{examId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and a.student_answer is not null and a.student_answer != '' and ifnull(a.grading_status, '0') != '1'

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id where a.exam_id = #{examId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and a.student_answer is not null and a.student_answer != '' and ifnull(a.grading_status, '0') = '1' and a.score is not null

select pq.question_id as questionId, min(pq.order_num) as orderNum, max(pq.question_type) as questionType, max(pq.question_content) as questionContent, max(pq.question_score) as questionScore, count(1) as participantCount, count(a.answer_id) as answeredCount, round(avg(ifnull(a.score, 0)), 1) as avgScore, round( sum(ifnull(a.score, 0)) * 100 / nullif(sum(ifnull(pq.question_score, 0)), 0), 1 ) as scoreRate, case when max(pq.question_type) in ('choice', 'judgment') then round(sum(case when a.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / count(1), 1) else null end as correctRate from biz_county_exam_paper_question pq left join biz_county_exam_answer a on a.exam_id = pq.exam_id and a.student_id = pq.student_id and a.question_id = pq.question_id where pq.exam_id = #{examId} group by pq.question_id order by min(pq.order_num) asc, pq.question_id asc

select a.answer_id as answerId, a.exam_id as examId, e.exam_name as examName, a.question_id as questionId, pq.question_content as questionContent, pq.question_score as questionScore, pq.file_path as materialPath, a.student_answer as studentAnswer, a.score as score, a.grading_status as gradingStatus, a.preview_status as previewStatus, a.preview_path as previewPath, a.preview_error_message as previewErrorMessage from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam e on a.exam_id = e.exam_id inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id where a.answer_id = #{answerId} and a.grader_id = #{graderId} and e.status = '2' and ifnull(e.grading_enabled, '0') = '1'

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam e on a.exam_id = e.exam_id inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id where a.grader_id = #{graderId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and e.status = '2' and ifnull(e.grading_enabled, '0') = '1'
and a.grading_status = #{gradingStatus}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_county_exam_answer (exam_id, student_id, question_id, student_answer, score, is_correct, grader_id, grading_status, answer_time, file_path, submit_time, typing_speed, accuracy_rate, completion_rate, preview_status, preview_path, preview_retry_count, preview_last_retry_time, preview_error_message) values (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{studentAnswer}, #{score}, #{isCorrect}, #{graderId}, #{gradingStatus}, #{answerTime}, #{filePath}, #{submitTime}, #{typingSpeed}, #{accuracyRate}, #{completionRate}, #{previewStatus}, #{previewPath}, #{previewRetryCount}, #{previewLastRetryTime}, #{previewErrorMessage})
mapper.update:
update biz_county_exam_answer set grader_id = #{graderId}, grading_status = ifnull(grading_status, '0') where answer_id in
#{answerId}

update biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id set a.grader_id = null, a.grading_status = '0' where a.exam_id = #{examId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and ifnull(a.grading_status, '0') != '1'

update biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id set a.grader_id = null, a.grading_status = '0', a.score = null where a.exam_id = #{examId} and pq.question_type = 'practical' and a.student_answer is not null and a.student_answer != ''

update biz_county_exam_answer set preview_status = #{previewStatus}, preview_path = #{previewPath}, preview_retry_count = #{previewRetryCount}, preview_last_retry_time = #{previewLastRetryTime}, preview_error_message = #{previewErrorMessage} where answer_id = #{answerId}

update biz_county_exam_answer set preview_status = 'converting', preview_path = null, preview_retry_count = ifnull(preview_retry_count, 0), preview_last_retry_time = #{claimedAt}, preview_error_message = null where answer_id = #{answerId} and preview_status = 'pending' and preview_path is null
mapper.select: select a.* from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam_paper_question pq on pq.exam_id = a.exam_id and pq.student_id = a.student_id and pq.question_id = a.question_id inner join biz_county_exam e on e.exam_id = a.exam_id where pq.question_type = 'practical' and e.status in ('1', '2') and a.student_answer is not null and a.student_answer != '' and (lower(a.student_answer) like '%.docx' or lower(a.student_answer) like '%.doc') and a.preview_path is null and ( (a.preview_status = 'failed' and (a.preview_last_retry_time is null or a.preview_last_retry_time <= #{retryBefore})) or (a.preview_status in ('pending', 'converting') and coalesce(a.preview_last_retry_time, a.submit_time) is not null and coalesce(a.preview_last_retry_time, a.submit_time) <= #{stuckBefore}) ) and ifnull(a.preview_retry_count, 0) < #{maxRetryCount} order by a.submit_time asc
